body_matches: The real production line pass draws pixels but emits `GL_INVALID_VALUE` in the game's forward-compatible OpenGL core context because it requests `glLineWidth 1.5`. This repair explicitly requests the supported width `1.0`. Context hints, shader opacity, mesh upload, draw call and cleanup remain unchanged.

- A private-Xvfb regression creates the production forward-compatible context, compiles the real line shader and invokes the actual line pass. Both ordinary/default-opacity and fading-opacity lines must produce framebuffer pixels without GL errors. Cleanup releases GL and GLFW resources; no public test-only API is added.
